title: Merge Two Binary Trees
problemStatement: Given two binary trees, create a new binary tree by merging overlapping nodes. When two nodes overlap, the new node's value is obtained by combining the corresponding node values according to the specified rule.
input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first tree. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second tree.
